verdict.rationale: Mixpanel ships a dedicated Funnels report that measures conversion through a series of events (docs-2) and markets finding drop-off points (docs-45). Properties support filtering (docs-16), the Query API can filter or break down events (docs-39), and Session Replay lets you follow up on why users drop off (docs-4). Missing for 10: funnel-specific documentation of filters and breakdowns (the evidence covers them only generically), detail on step-level drop-off visualization, and independent hands-on corroboration of the funnels report itself.
